files.README.md:
# Brackenmill Components — night stock positions

The nightly sync consolidates all three depots into one row per stock
code, so every stock code appears exactly once. Columns (tab separated):

    sku, warehouse, zone, bin, qty_on_hand, unit_cost_gbp,
    reorder_point, supplier_ref, last_counted

RLC-44xx codes are the passive component kits; a trailing A marks the
assortpack variant of a kit, which is stocked and priced separately.
Neighbouring four-digit codes are distinct products, not typos: the
position of a code is exactly the row whose first column equals it.
